about_the_game:
Fly, race, and roll with Snoopy like never before — The Joe Cool Fun Pack celebrates 75 years of Peanuts with flair, fun, and four fresh challenges, featuring:

• EXCLUSIVE "JOE COOL" OUTFIT – Suit up in Snoopy’s persona and most legendary look. Beagle swagger has never looked cooler!

• 2 RED BARON MINI GAMES – Take flight in the Sopwith Camel as Snoopy with high-flying challenges that will test your reflexes:

- Frozen Cave: Carefully navigate ice trenches, avoid falling icicles and a multitude of icy obstacles!​

- Scorching Desert: Put your flying ace skills to the test as you fly through canyons, and even inside a pyramid, avoiding sand tornadoes and numerous obstacles!​

• 2 PEANUTS SOAPBOX RACING MINI GAMES – Strap in, start your engines, and 3, 2, 1, GO!:

- The Great Pumpkin Patch: Race through The Great Pumpkin Patch, avoiding pumpkins & tangly vines, to claim victory!​

- Off-Road Challenge: Race through a forest filled with jumps and obstacles as you try to avoid tree trunks, mud pits and even falling trees. ​

• The 75th ANNIVERSARY COMIC COLLECTION: 75 full-color comics readable via an in-game viewer, celebrating our favorite gang!​

Whether you're flying through frozen caves or channeling your inner Joe Cool, this bundle brings bonus fun worthy of the world’s most beloved beagle.
